title: The Patternmaker Behind the Designer
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: The Patternmaker Behind the Designer: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: The patternmaker is not a neutral copying machine: pattern work carries design intention into geometry, fit, construction, repeatability, and the body through skilled decisions that deserve explicit evidence, authority, and credit.
frames.alt: Title plate for The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: Construction evidence can outlive the operating house—but only if the physical object and record stay paired.
frames.credit: Gift of Miss Eva Drexel Dahlgren, 1976

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · BRIEF — What is the design asking the pattern to do?. Record silhouette, balance, ease, movement, material behavior, size range, construction, finish, cost, time, accessibility, and the non-negotiable visual idea. A sketch alone rarely carries all of this.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what is the design asking the pattern to do? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · JUDGMENT — Which decisions belong to the patternmaker?. Log the alteration, reason, evidence, person deciding, person approving, affected sizes and materials, and whether the change is technical, aesthetic, safety-related, or commercial. Skilled translation should remain attributable.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping which decisions belong to the patternmaker? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · FIT — Whose body becomes the standard?. Identify the block, fit model or measurement source, sample size, grading method, movement test, wearer feedback, and excluded bodies. A technically repeatable pattern can still institutionalize a narrow body assumption.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping whose body becomes the standard? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · RETAIN — Can the knowledge survive the specialist’s absence?. Preserve pattern version, annotation, toile images where permitted, fitting decisions, known failures, material constraints, maker credit, access rules, and a route for future questions. The file is evidence; narration explains the judgment.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the knowledge survive the specialist’s absence? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Calling patternmaking authorship can illuminate judgment but also blur distinct legal categories or erase sewing, fitting, grading, textile, and production labor. The answer is not to replace one hero with another. It is to make the chain of contribution and decision precise.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
